value: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (2021). Oil and Natural Gas Sector: Emission Standards for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review. Background Technical Support Document for the Proposed New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) and Emissions Guidelines (EG), 40 CFR Part 60 subpart OOOOb (NSPS) and subpart OOOOc (EG). October 2021. Research Triangle Park, NC: Office of Air Quality Planning and Standards. Docket ID No. EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-0166.

Targeted pass on the 390-page proposal TSD; extracted only chapters the 2022 and 2023 TSDs did not revise and that still underlie the final rule: Ch.5 well completions (REC, completion combustion, combined; per event), Ch.6 storage vessels/tank batteries (flare and VRU costs for model control systems 4, 8-11, new and existing; new-flare cost for systems 0-8 equals the RIA tank battery flare already in epa_2023_001 and is not reloaded), Ch.7.1 reciprocating compressors (fixed-schedule and monitored rod packing replacement by segment), Ch.10 processing plant LDAR (options 1B, 2B, 4B, small and large plants), Ch.11 liquids unloading (BMP cost-effectiveness ranges; non-venting technique capital ranges), Ch.12 compressor station fugitives (quarterly OGI by segment). Superseded and not extracted: Ch.7.2 centrifugal compressors (epa_2022_002), Ch.8 pneumatic controllers and Ch.9 pumps and Ch.13 associated gas (epa_2023_002), Ch.12 well-site OGI (replaced by FEAST modelling in epa_2022_002); Ch.14 (abandoned wells, pigging) is qualitative. Page numbers are printed chapter-page numbers. Costs 2019 USD where the chapter states it; Ch.10 and Ch.11 non-venting costs have no stated price year (2021 used, flagged). Tons are US short tons; capacity = methane avoided per unit per year (target ch4); completion reductions are per event (other-values). Items already in epa_2023_001 (RIA) not repeated: tank battery flare 79,352/22,840, rod-packing monitoring 597/yr, liquids-unloading labour 65/event and 29/36% reductions. Source defects: Table 7-8 column Capital Cost of Replacing Rod Packing holds annualized values; Table 10-19 annual costs for options B equal Table 10-18 (no credit applied) and Table 10-20 large-plant annual costs differ from Table 10-18; text 67,800 vs range 67,880 for soap launchers plus velocity tubing; Table 6-9/6-11 model system 0 VOC 4.0 vs 3.00.
